Agent Name: WebServing_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebServing_Expert failed to correctly identify and verify the first citation reference link on Carl Nebel's Wikipedia page. Instead of rigorously extracting the actual first citation link from the Wikipedia HTML structure, the agent operated on an assumption that the citation linked directly to the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston (MFAH) collection page. This assumption led to an incorrect image URL being fetched, which ultimately caused the `UnidentifiedImageError` during the OCR process. This error was the root cause of the task's failure to extract the latest chronological year date from the image.
